items.html: Now they are two corners (pe'ot), on the two sides of the head; hence there are two Names, Elohim and Elohim. But you must know that, since they are in a high place, namely the head of Arich Anpin, where the judgments are covered and hidden, it is impossible for them to be literally Names of Elohim. Rather, they are two Names of Metzpatz [Mantzeptatz], which is the interchange of YHVH; for Elohim in its filling of Yods is in gematria three hundred, the number of Metzpatz; and likewise the Name YHVH in the interchange of Atbash is Metzpatz.
